hits.name: Presales Consultant

You will take full technical ownership of a North American book of accounts, lead technical evaluations, and set closed deals up for a fast launch. Partner with Account Managers and Account Executives to run discovery with customer service leaders, uncover operational challenges, and demonstrate AI solutions.
Design automation-first solutions for complex deals, lead technical evaluations and proofs of concept, and take full technical ownership of a North American book of accounts.
Own the technical answers to RFPs and security questionnaires, grow technical win rate, influenced pipeline, and closed ARR across your book.
